title: Practice: Rear Hook Elbow
source: Practice Mode tutorial. The move is in the app's Technique Library (practiceData.js › Muay Thai › Rear Hook Elbow: cues, mistakes, next), named from the owner's footage by Claude; the owner corrects the name at approval. Thai: Sok Tat (ศอกตัด). Footage: the owner's clip 3 (ring, 2026-10-31), raw-footage/practice/p3.mp4. One shot; lead and rear elbows alternate, the rear-side reps land at about 4.2, 6.0 and 8.4 s.

props.description: The hook elbow from the rear side
props.hookSub: Rear hook elbow. Sok Tat. 20 seconds.

cues.text: Step in as the elbow comes up
cues.label: STEP IN
cues.say: Coach: "The rear foot steps as the elbow lifts. Arrive and strike together."

cues.label: LEVEL
cues.say: Coach: "Flat and level, eyebrow height. The point does the cutting."

cues.label: COVER
cues.say: Coach: "As it swings, the shoulder rolls up and hides your chin."

watch.fix: Elbow comes up and straight across
watch.label: WIND-UP
watch.say: Coach: "Pull it behind your head and they see it a mile off. Up, then across. That's it."

next.name: Lead Uppercut Elbow
next.description: The rising elbow under the chin, lead side
